name: TruncatedText
whenToUse: Long user data on one line where wrapping would break the layout: file names, domains, list-row descriptions, a chosen value in a trigger.
Your own cells and rows in a table or list that truncate.

whenNotToUse.text: Short interface labels: column headers, nav and tab labels, buttons, field labels
Running text and descriptions the reader needs in full

anatomy.description: one line, ellipsis when it doesn’t fit.
the whole text; appears only while the text is cut, on hover and on keyboard focus.

do.caption: A long file name: cut on one line, the whole name in the tooltip.

dont.caption: A label the interface owns. Make it wrap; at 200% text a cut label is lost content.

a11y: WCAG 1.4.4 / 1.4.12: with text at 200% or wider spacing, cut text must stay reachable. The tooltip shows it to sighted users; screen readers read the whole text from the DOM.
The tooltip opens on keyboard focus of the control around the text (a row link, a trigger). Cut text with nothing focusable around it becomes a tab stop.
The tooltip is visual only (aria-hidden), so the text isn’t read twice.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render onto your own element (e.g. a heading) instead of a `<span>`.
